description: Stock screening filters. Hard filters are always enforced by the pipeline. Toggle filters are optional client-side restrictions.

universe.min_market_cap_description: Pre-filter for liquidity. Only stocks above this market cap are included in the scannable universe.

pe_ratio.label: P/E Ratio (Industry-Relative)
pe_ratio.description: P/E must be below the lower quartile (25th percentile) of the stock's SEC SIC industry group.

peg_ratio.label: PEG Ratio
peg_ratio.description: P/E divided by growth rate. Below 1 = growth at a reasonable price.

price_to_fcf.label: Price / Free Cash Flow
price_to_fcf.description: How much you pay per dollar of free cash flow. Lower = more cash generation per dollar invested.

debt_to_equity.label: Debt / Equity
debt_to_equity.description: Total debt relative to shareholders equity. Below 1 = conservative balance sheet. Override: passes if ICR > 3.0.

quick_ratio.label: Quick Ratio
quick_ratio.description: Liquid assets / current liabilities. Above 1 = can cover short-term obligations.

operating_margin.label: Operating Margin (%)
operating_margin.description: Percentage of revenue kept after operating costs. Override: passes if Revenue Growth > 20% (investing heavily for growth).

est_lt_revenue_growth.label: Forward Revenue Growth (%)
est_lt_revenue_growth.description: Forward revenue growth CAGR from analyst estimates. Positive = analysts expect top-line growth. Missing = fail.

analyst_recommendation.label: Analyst Rec ≤ 3.0 (Hold or better)
analyst_recommendation.description: Only show stocks where analyst consensus is Hold or better. Excludes stocks with no analyst coverage.

target_price_upside.label: Target Upside ≥ 20%
target_price_upside.description: Only show stocks at least 20% below analyst price target. Excludes stocks with no target.

est_lt_growth.label: EPS Growth 5Y > 0%
est_lt_growth.description: Only show stocks where analysts project positive EPS growth over the next 3-5 years. Excludes stocks with no estimates.

eps_growth_yoy.label: EPS Growth YoY > 0%
eps_growth_yoy.description: Only show stocks with positive trailing EPS growth year-over-year. Excludes stocks with declining earnings.

positive_operating_margin.label: Positive Operating Margin
positive_operating_margin.description: Only show stocks with positive operating margin. Excludes companies currently investing heavily at a loss.

forward_pe.label: Forward P/E
forward_pe.description: Skip if absent. Fail if present and > 20.
